# Asif Iqbal

> Personal portfolio and resume site for Asif Iqbal, a PhD researcher at Virginia Tech working on Machine Learning applied to Phylo-oncology, Genomics, and Bioinformatics.

## Pages

- [Home](https://asifiqbal.xyz/): Introduction, skills summary, and embedded resume.
- [Overview](https://asifiqbal.xyz/overview): Background, research focus, and interests.
- [Experience & Education](https://asifiqbal.xyz/experience_education): Work history and academic background.
- [Projects & Certifications](https://asifiqbal.xyz/projects_certificates): Selected projects and certifications.
- [Awards & Interests](https://asifiqbal.xyz/awards_interests): Awards, honors, and personal interests.
- [Resume & Blog](https://asifiqbal.xyz/resume): Downloadable resume (PDF) and an embedded personal blog.
